content:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: P2 - sudden increase in token tail latency and intermittent 504s for batch streaming endpoints in eu-central-1. Paging harper_oncall and felix_runtime. Auto-ticket created INC-2026-211.
harper_oncall: Acknowledged. Seeing 99th token latency ~2.4s (baseline ~170ms). Which model variants are implicated?
felix_runtime: Metrics spike correlates to model variant artemis-12b-q4b under mixed streaming + long-context workloads. Recent rollout of a batching-controller optimization at 02:10 UTC increased aggressive coalescing. Suspect interaction between coalescing + KV prefetch scheduling.
nora_sre: Alerts show queue_depth and kv_prefetch_backpressure spiking together. Autoscaler didn't add nodes because node_cpu stayed <70% but decode_thread_stall metric rose. Also admission-controller recorded many inflight requests from a handful of clients.
mike_support: Several customers reported incomplete responses and one reported failed retries that caused heavier load. Ticket CS-5119 created. Acct teams notified.
harper_oncall: Immediate mitigations proposed: 1) revert batching-controller optimization coalescing changes in eu-central-1 for artemis-12b-q4b, 2) toggle KV prefetch to conservative mode for this variant, 3) enforce per-client inflight cap and backoff.
felix_runtime: Rolling config change to revert coalescing:```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  "https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/regions/eu-central-1/models/artemis-12b-q4b/config" \
  -d '{"batching": {"coalesce_window_ms": 0}}'
```
deploy-bot: config update submitted: regions/eu-central-1/models/artemis-12b-q4b/config (user: felix_runtime) -> AUTO_APPROVED and applied.
nora_sre: I pushed KV prefetch to conservative: kv_prefetch_mode=low, and reduced max_batch_size to 6 for artemis-12b-q4b in eu-central-1. Also tightened admission-controller inflight per-client to 8.
harper_oncall: After these mitigations latency 95th dropped to 260ms within ~4m, 99th down to ~420ms. Some residual 504s cleared. Good progress.
felix_runtime: I'm also enabling extra logging for the decode thread and KV interaction to capture any contention points. Endpoint: /internal/debug/threads?model=artemis-12b-q4b.
mike_support: Confirmed with two customers that responses now arrive complete. One customer requested a post-incident writeup and optional call.
harper_oncall: Root cause hypothesis (initial): new batching coalescer caused larger effective batches in presence of bursty clients; combined with q4b quant decode path that used an aggressive KV prefetcher produced scheduling contention and rare decode stalls, causing head-of-line blocking and timeouts. Secondary: autoscaler signal set didn't include decode_thread_stall or queue_depth -> delayed scale-up.
anya_pm: Let's schedule RCA. Proposed: 2026-04-04 14:00 UTC. Agenda: timeline, logs, RCA, remediation plan, customer comms.
mike_support: 14:00 UTC works for account follow-ups. I'll prepare impact list and timeline for customers.
felix_runtime: Planned mitigations and follow-ups: I'm going to open a PR to gate the coalescer change behind a canary flag and add KV-aware tests.
nora_sre: I'll add an alert for decode_thread_stall > 3m and add queue_depth to autoscaler signals. Also propose a runbook: if kv_prefetch_p95 > 300ms, reduce coalesce_window_ms to 0 and lower batch size.
harper_oncall: Action items (owner - ETA):
- ACTION-211-A: Rollback coalescer globally for artemis-12b-q4b until gated canary exists (felix_runtime) - ETA: 2026-03-31
- ACTION-211-B: Add KV-aware canary tests exercising long-context streaming + prefetch (felix_runtime) - ETA: 2026-04-07
- ACTION-211-C: Instrumentation: add decode_thread_stall metrics and correlate with kv_lookup_latency (nora_sre) - ETA: 2026-03-30
- ACTION-211-D: Autoscaler: include queue_depth & decode_thread_stall in scaling policy (nora_sre) - ETA: 2026-04-10
- ACTION-211-E: Customer comms & postmortem doc (mike_support + anya_pm) - ETA: 2026-04-02
- ACTION-211-F: Implement safety fallback in runtime: if KV prefetch p99 > threshold then auto-disable prefetch and reduce batch sizes (felix_runtime + nora_sre) - ETA: 2026-04-12
felix_runtime: I'll add unit+integration tests that simulate prefetch backpressure and verify streaming stability. Will attach PR links here.
nora_sre: Short-term alert rule added: if kv_prefetch_p95 > 300ms and stream_error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, page oncall and reduce max_batch_size automatically.
harper_oncall: Severity: P2  partial customer impact, impact window ~40 minutes, 4 customers affected. Live traffic now mitigated. Postmortem required.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-211 status changed: MITIGATED -> POSTMORTEM_REQUIRED (owner: anya_pm).
anya_pm: Calendar invite: "RCA - INC-2026-211 - artemis-12b-q4b coalescer & KV prefetch" scheduled 2026-04-04 14:00 UTC. Please attach logs and any PR diffs. Link: https://calendar.redwood.company/evt/pm-789 (internal).
mike_support: Drafting customer email with timeline and mitigation steps; will post to #customer-success for review and cc affected account owners.
felix_runtime: Note for postmortem: quant q4b showed measurable throughput gains in bench, but bench didn't include KV prefetch under streaming long-context. We'll update perf gating to include KV streaming scenarios.
nora_sre: Recommend adding a canary policy such that any change affecting batching or prefetching goes to 0.5% of traffic for 24h and must pass KV streaming smoke-tests.
harper_oncall: Closing live mitigation. Thread will remain open for postmortem and tracking. If anyone sees regressions, ping me directly. Thanks all :thumbsup:
